acceptance: A complete release-v2 rehearsal (dlv2-52a) runs on the real runner and each listed fix is confirmed or reopened with shard evidence. The SingleStore wrapper gets a live bulk-load check and the loosened test gets a meaningful assertion.
description: No release-v2 run has passed UAT, and these fixes could not be run locally (no Docker, 26 GiB free disk): CedarDB/Presto/Trino query-level readiness assumes psql and curl exist in those images (falls back to the old healthcheck if missing); the Velox container exit cause and tmpfs exec fix; SF1 timings measured only on a developer machine; Spark failures from the rc2 shard ran on Java 25 and may not reproduce; SingleStore bulk load now goes through a new SingleStoreConnectionWrapper (layering fix for core importing platforms.singlestore) covered by two wrapper unit tests only, the earlier live bulk-load sweep having run through the old path; test_write_primitives_overrides_name_singlestore_not_mysql was loosened from an exact count to non-empty in one branch.
